* Portable Artifact Contract
:PROPERTIES:
:CONTRACT_ID: orgize.test.portable-artifact.v1
:CONTRACT_SCOPE: document
:END:
#+begin_src scheme :org-contract
(assert-org-element "portable.source-present" error
  (bindings)
  (org-elements org-data (property-contains source-text "") (at scope))
  (expect exactly 1))
(assert-org-element "portable.no-host-path" error
  (bindings)
  (org-elements org-data (property-local-path source-text) (at scope))
  (expect exactly 0))
#+end_src
